'''Credit ingots''' were a form of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] currency, similar to the standard [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chip]].

==Design==
The credit ingot appeared as small, flat, rectangular bars of [[Gold/Legends|gold]] and [[Silver/Legends|silver]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] metal. Each ingot was between two and three inches in length; the silver ones being a bit longer than the gold ones. The ingots had symbols stamped onto its surface, including the symbol of the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]] ({{Cr}}).

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this form of currency was valuable in several parts of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used some to get onto a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] owned by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], while searching for his lost [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], later threw a handful of these ingots onto the floor of a [[Cantina|bar]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underground]] as a distraction in order to escape a violent brawl while in search of information regarding [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].

The ingots were also exchanged on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. They were used as a bribe given to a [[Unidentified Mandalorian customs official|Mandalorian customs official]] by [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] during the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|conspiracy]] that plagued the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]].

On Coruscant, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and R2-D2 had 40 credits in credit ingots in their possession while on a errand to purchase [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]] for a dinner party hosted by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] for Senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]] of [[Roona/Legends|Roona]], a influential member of [[Military Oversight Committee/Legends|Senate Military Oversight Committee]].

[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] paid notorious bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] a briefcase full of ingots for floor plans to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Once Cad Bane had freed Ziro the Hutt from prison on Coruscant, Ziro was brought to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where Jabba planned to have him killed. After betraying and killing [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] and recovering the [[Holodiary/Legends|holodiary]] containing all the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council's]] dirty dealings, Jabba the Hutt paid the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] in a handful of credit ingots.

== Denominational Values ==
While the values of the credits are not stated directly, mathematical deduction can provide a likely estimate using information from [[Evil Plans]]. In the episode, C-3PO and R2-D2 were given 40 credits in the form of two gold ingots and a silver ingot. Assuming that gold ingots are more valuable than the silver ingots, this leaves six possible integer value pairs: 14 and 12, 15 and 10, 16 and 8, 17 and 6, 18 and 4, and 19 and 2. 

A useful currency system should be well-divisible, so 14, 17, 18, and 19 are unlikely values for the gold ingot. In the episode, C-3PO is not shown to be given change, but it is inferred that change is given as C-3PO states they have 8 credits left. This rules out 16 and 8 as the denomination values as they would have had perfect change for the vendor, yet they gave the vendor all three credit ingots which Anakin had given them. 

This leaves the only logical value conclusion as follows: 

Bronze - 1 Credit (Base)

Silver - 10 Credits

Gold - 15 Credits
